LanguageData.ALConfigCuriosityEatingLabel: Prevent animals from eating random stuff
LanguageData.ALConfigCuriosityEatingTooltip: It mostly prevents your animals from eating drugs without a nutrition and stuff outside their allowed zones. They would still eat your food if it is in their allowed zone.
LanguageData.ALConfigHostilePredatorsLabel: Predators hunting your pawns are considered hostile by your entire faction
LanguageData.ALConfigHostilePredatorsTooltip: This does not change threat response of your pawns, it only makes them able to recognize a threat.
LanguageData.ALConfigMeatConversionLabel: Convert any generic animal meat into chicken meat upon butchering
LanguageData.ALConfigMeatConversionTooltip: This does not affect already butchered meat.
LanguageData.ALConfigShearCorpsesTooltip: Only works with vanilla "shearable", not exotic resource used by some mods.
LanguageData.ALConfigMedicalAlertsTooltip: Shows right-hand alerts for when colony animals are injured, need rescuing or in critical medical condition.
LanguageData.ALConfigTamenessDecayThresholdLabel: Wildness threshold for tameness decay {0}%. Vanilla: 10.1%.
LanguageData.ALConfigTamenessDecayThresholdTooltip: Set to 100% to prevent losing tameness for all animals.
LanguageData.ALConfigTrainingDecaySpeedFactorTooltip: Set to 1% to make it as slow as possible.
LanguageData.ALConfigTradeHintsLabel: Tags for animals in trade and caravan interfaces
LanguageData.ALConfigTradeHintsTooltip: Shows animal's sex, training and wool growth.
LanguageData.ALConfigAnimalsCanUseFoodDispenserLabel: Allow animals to use nutrient paste dispenser
LanguageData.ALConfigAnimalsCanUseFoodDispenserToolti: Animals would be capable of pressing that button. Warining: contains a minor detour (extremely unlikely chance to have a conflict). If animals still don't use the dispenser, check if the building iself is in the allowed area.
LanguageData.ALConfigHaulingMTBTooltip: 'MTB' stands for 'Mean Time Between'. Setting to 0 drastically increases productiveness, but can affect performance with large amount of trained animals.
LanguageData.ALConfigAlwaysShowRelationsTooltip: By default, only relations with named animals are displayed. This allows to see all of them.
LanguageData.ALConfigToxicBuildupRotTooltip: By default, animals killed while having major toxic buildup have a chance to rot immediately. It is intended to make toxic fallout more difficult, but has a side effect of cobras being unable to eat their prey, so they tend to kill every small animal on map and die from starvation. Set to 0% to entirely remove rot chance, set to 100% for vanilla formula.
LanguageData.ALConfigTamingAgeFactorLabel: Young animals are easier to handle
LanguageData.ALConfigTamingAgeFactorTooltip: Makes non-adult animals easier to tame and train, effectively reducing their wildness. Proportinal to their relative age - newborn are much easier, while almost adult are barely affected.
LanguageData.ALConfigComeWhenCalledLabel: Obedient animals come when called for training or play
LanguageData.ALConfigComeWhenCalledTooltip: Animals with Obedience training will come to the handler instead of forcing the handler to chase them, dropping whatever they were doing. They will not be called while fighting, fleeing, drafted or otherwise unavailable for interaction by the game's own rules.
LanguageData.ALConfigPlayWithAnimalsLabel: Allow playing with animals as recreation
LanguageData.ALConfigPlayWithAnimalsTooltip: Pawns capable of animal handling can play with colony animals for joy. Bonded and high-petness animals are preferred. High-skill handlers may also interact with wild animals for a chance to tame them.
LanguageData.ALConfigShowExtraDisplayStatsLabel: Show production stats for modded animal resources
LanguageData.ALConfigShowExtraDisplayStatsTooltip: Vanilla info cards only list milk and wool. This adds the same rows for custom gatherable resources used by other mods.
LanguageData.AL_ResourceTypeDesc: This creature produces a gatherable resource that is neither milk nor wool. Added by another mod, so the numbers follow that mod's rules.
LanguageData.AL_ResourceAmountDesc: The amount of this resource gathered from the creature each time.
LanguageData.AL_ResourceIntervalDesc: The time the creature needs between gatherings.
LanguageData.AL_ResourcePerYearDesc: The amount of this resource gathered over the course of a year.\n\nThis is calculated from the amount and the gathering interval.
LanguageData.AL_ResourceValueDesc: The market value of one unit of this resource.
LanguageData.AL_ResourceValuePerYearDesc: The market value of one year's worth of this resource from this creature.\n\nThis is calculated from the amount per year and the market value.
LanguageData.AL_RandomProductDesc: Each gathering yields one of: {0}.\n\nThe market value shown is the average over these.
LanguageData.AL_VariableProductDesc: The product depends on the animal's current condition or surroundings. Possible products: {0}.
LanguageData.AL_ResourceExtraDesc: Each gathering has this chance to also yield the given number of extra items, of one kind from: {0}.
LanguageData.AnimalNeedsTreatmentDesc: These animals need medical treatment. Without it, they may die of their wounds, or their wounds may become permanent.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.AnimalsNeedRescueDesc:
These animals are incapacitated on the ground:

{0}
Send a colonist to rescue them and carry them back to bed.

(To rescue, select a colonist, then right click on the victim and select Rescue.)
